notes: The excerpt (catalog pages 76-77) prints no section titled Computer and Network Specialist (Network+). It holds the end of a computer business information systems degree, the Certificate of Achievement, Cyber Security Specialist (17 units), the Certificate of Achievement, Management Information Systems (16 units), and the start of an Education section. No requirements were recorded so that another award's courses are not attributed to this one.

The Management Information Systems certificate shares CBIS 1, CBIS 13 and CBIS 15 with the closed list. However, it also requires CBIS 17 and CBIS 19 and does not include CSIS 10, so it does not appear to be this program. A reviewer should check other pages of the 2026-2027 catalog for the Network+ certificate. It may have been discontinued or renamed.
The degree section on page 76 lists ADJU 1 and ADJU 3 as required core courses for a CBIS major. This looks like a catalog error, and that section is not this award in any case.
